d: Watch as Firstpost breaks down Addis Ababa's dramatic public display of captured weapons, drones, and artillery seized from Tigrayan fighters. Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's government claims documents and camouflage prove that neighbouring nations—specifically Eritrea and Sudan—have been arming insurgent elements. As diplomatic ties shatter, embassies close, and Ethiopia bolsters its skies with Russian Su-35 fighter jets, this high-stakes standoff threatens to ignite the entire Horn of Africa and destabilise vital Red Sea shipping corridors. Alyson Le Grange brings you more on this story on…
